query: SELECT g.id, g.owner_id, g.visibility AS "visibility: _", g.title, g.description, g.deadline AS "deadline: _", g.status AS "status: _", g.labels, g.created_at AS "created_at: _", g.updated_at AS "updated_at: _", m.total AS "milestone_count!", m.done AS "completed_milestone_count!" FROM goals g CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS total, count(completed_at) AS done FROM milestones WHERE goal_id = g.id AND owner_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL) m WHERE g.owner_id = $1 AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND ($2::text IS NULL OR g.status = $2) AND ($3::text IS NULL OR g.title ILIKE $3) AND ($4::text IS NULL OR g.labels @> ARRAY[$4::text]) AND ($5::boolean IS NULL OR (g.deadline IS NOT NULL) = $5) AND ($6::date IS NULL OR (COALESCE(g.deadline, $8::date), g.id) > ($6::date, $7::uuid)) ORDER BY COALESCE(g.deadline, $8::date) ASC, g.id ASC LIMIT $9
